attestation_record.station_policy_evidence: Owner statement in the September 27, 2026 working session: the 30-day and 90-day station retention periods were confirmed with the network's authority.
attestation_record.tester_program_evidence: Owner attestation of August 28, 2026: the 90-day tester-program retention claim is accurate.

attested_accurate_claims.served_claim: For verified deletion requests, 24seven.FM deletes or anonymizes personally identifiable account and profile data from active systems within 30 days.
Favorites and account preferences are deleted with the account within the same period.
Ordinary song-request records, operational logs, Chat and forum data, and normal diagnostics/server/IP logs are kept for no more than 90 days.
Encrypted backups are retained for no more than 90 days.

The coordinator stops program access promptly after a verified withdrawal request and deletes or anonymizes private tester intake, assignments, feedback, and invitation correspondence within 90 days of a verified withdrawal, deletion request, rejection, or program-close decision.

To request access, correction, or deletion of station-side account data, email morg@24seven.fm with the station name, the account name, and the request type, or use the applicable station's Contact/Feedback system to reach Network/Station Administration.
A record may be retained only while an active security, abuse, fraud, or rule-enforcement investigation requires it, and is deleted when no longer required.

required_scopes: station retention, deletion, and supported privacy-request contact
tester-program retention, deletion or anonymization, and mailbox handling
operational_attestation.rule: The retention attestation is recorded separately from confirmation of the supported privacy-request contact. Before a public privacy release, the designated owner must confirm every required scope; if any served numerical claim is inaccurate, the attestation must list that exact served route and wording before an interim correction and its separately approved release evidence are allowed.

interim_correction.rule: Use only after a named owner attests that a specific currently served claim is inaccurate. Every affected claim must exactly match an entry in the attestation's attested_inaccurate_claims list and retain exact wording, separate production approval, validation, and rollback evidence; this path is intentionally independent of the full replacement gate.

privacy_publication_gate.rule: A public privacy release must use --require-public-privacy-ready and remains blocked until the native notice and tester-program addendum are reviewed, legacy surfaces have a recorded disposition, an approved replacement source exists, and the owner attestation is recorded.
